title: karis-ky Escrow Contract ABI
description: Machine-readable specification of the karis-ky escrow smart contract interface for SDK consumption. Auto-generated from contract source.

contract.name: LiquifactEscrow
contract.description: Holds investor funds for an invoice until settlement on Stellar Soroban

entrypoints.name: init
entrypoints.description: Create an invoice escrow; binds funding token, treasury, optional registry. One-shot — panics if called twice.

params.name: admin
params.description: Governance address; controls holds, maturity, admin transfer

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: ASCII alphanumeric + underscore, max 32 chars (e.g. 'INV001')

params.name: sme_address
params.description: Invoice issuer; authorized to call settle and withdraw

params.name: amount
params.description: Funding target in token base units (7 decimals)

params.name: yield_bps
params.description: Base annualized yield in basis points (800 = 8%); range 0..=10_000

params.name: maturity
params.description: Unix timestamp after which settle is allowed; 0 = no maturity gate

params.name: funding_token
params.description: SEP-41 token contract address bound to this escrow (immutable)

params.name: registry
params.description: Optional registry hint for indexers; not an on-chain authority

params.name: treasury
params.description: Receives terminal dust sweeps; immutable after init

params.name: yield_tiers
params.description: Optional tiered yield ladder; null to omit

params.name: min_contribution
params.description: Minimum per-call funding floor; null for no floor

params.name: max_unique_investors
params.description: Cap on distinct investor addresses; null for unlimited

params.name: max_per_investor
params.description: Per-investor contribution cap; null for unlimited

params.name: legal_hold_clear_delay
params.description: Minimum delay (seconds) for two-phase legal hold clear

params.name: funding_deadline
params.description: Ledger timestamp after which funding is rejected

params.name: yield_slippage_threshold
params.description: Bps threshold for yield slippage detection (0..=10_000)

entrypoints.name: fund
entrypoints.description: Record investor principal. Moves status open→funded when target met. Use for ALL deposits after first from a given address.

params.name: investor
params.description: Investor address whose contribution is recorded

params.name: amount
params.description: Principal amount in token base units; must be positive

entrypoints.name: fund_with_commitment
entrypoints.description: First deposit only per investor. Selects tiered yield based on lock commitment.

params.name: investor
params.description: Investor address (first deposit only for this address)

params.name: amount
params.description: Principal amount in token base units

params.name: committed_lock_secs
params.description: Lock duration in seconds; selects tier from YieldTierTable

entrypoints.name: fund_batch
entrypoints.description: Process multiple investor contributions in a single call. Max 50 entries.

params.name: entries
params.description: Vector of (investor_address, amount) pairs; max 50

entrypoints.name: settle
entrypoints.description: Mark a funded escrow as settled (status funded→settled). SME auth required; maturity enforced.

entrypoints.name: withdraw
entrypoints.description: SME pulls funded liquidity (status funded→withdrawn). Alternative terminal path.

entrypoints.name: claim_investor_payout
entrypoints.description: Records a payout claim marker after settlement. Accounting record only.

params.name: investor
params.description: Investor address recording the claim

entrypoints.name: cancel_funding
entrypoints.description: Admin cancels the escrow before it was funded. Investors may then refund.

entrypoints.name: refund
entrypoints.description: Investor reclaims principal after cancellation. Contribution zeroed before transfer.

params.name: investor
params.description: Investor address reclaiming funds

entrypoints.name: sweep_terminal_dust
entrypoints.description: Treasury sweeps rounding residue from a terminal escrow. Capped at MAX_DUST_SWEEP_AMOUNT.

params.name: amount
params.description: Sweep amount; max 100_000_000 base units

entrypoints.name: set_legal_hold
entrypoints.description: Admin activates or clears compliance hold. Blocks risk-bearing transitions when active.

params.name: active
params.description: true = enable hold, false = clear hold

entrypoints.name: clear_legal_hold
entrypoints.description: Admin convenience wrapper to clear legal hold. Respects two-phase clear delay if configured.

entrypoints.name: request_clear_legal_hold
entrypoints.description: Request to clear legal hold; starts the two-phase delay timer.

entrypoints.name: update_maturity
entrypoints.description: Admin updates the maturity timestamp. Only allowed in open status.

params.name: new_maturity
params.description: New unix timestamp for maturity gate

entrypoints.name: update_funding_target
entrypoints.description: Admin updates the funding target. Must be >= funded_amount; only in open status.

params.name: new_target
params.description: New funding target; must be positive and >= funded_amount

entrypoints.name: lower_max_unique_investors
entrypoints.description: Admin lowers the investor cap. Must be strictly lower and >= current funder count.

params.name: new_cap
params.description: New cap; must be strictly less than current cap

entrypoints.name: propose_admin
entrypoints.description: Admin proposes a successor admin. Pending admin must accept to complete handover.

params.name: new_admin
params.description: Proposed new admin; must differ from current

entrypoints.name: accept_admin
entrypoints.description: Pending admin accepts the role. Finalizes the admin handover.

entrypoints.name: migrate
entrypoints.description: Schema version gate. Typed errors on all paths in current release — extend before calling.

params.name: from_version
params.description: Version to migrate from

returns.description: No return value (panics on all paths)

entrypoints.name: set_investors_allowlisted
entrypoints.description: Admin batch-sets allowlist status for investors. Max 32 per batch.

params.name: investors
params.description: Addresses to allowlist/block (max 32)

params.name: allowed
params.description: true = add to allowlist, false = remove

entrypoints.name: set_allowlist_active
entrypoints.description: Admin toggles the allowlist gate. When active, only allowlisted investors may fund.

params.name: active
params.description: true = enforce allowlist, false = open funding

entrypoints.name: bind_primary_attestation_hash
entrypoints.description: Admin sets a single-write 32-byte attestation digest (e.g. SHA-256 of legal bundle).

params.name: digest
params.description: 32-byte hash digest; single-set

entrypoints.name: append_attestation_digest
entrypoints.description: Admin appends to bounded attestation audit log. Max 32 entries.

params.name: digest
params.description: 32-byte digest to append

entrypoints.name: revoke_attestation_digest
entrypoints.description: Admin revokes an attestation at the given log index. Preserves original for audit.

params.name: index
params.description: Index in attestation append log to revoke

entrypoints.name: record_sme_collateral_commitment
entrypoints.description: SME records collateral pledge metadata. Record-only — not proof of custody.

params.name: asset
params.description: Off-chain asset symbol (cannot be empty)

params.name: amount
params.description: Reported collateral amount; must be positive

entrypoints.name: rotate_beneficiary
entrypoints.description: Change the SME (beneficiary) address. Blocked by legal hold; only before settlement.

params.name: new_sme
params.description: New beneficiary address; must differ from current

entrypoints.name: verify_asset_custody
entrypoints.description: Compare contract's token balance to recorded funded_amount. Returns discrepancy.

entrypoints.name: init_from_template
entrypoints.description: Initialize an escrow from a named template (fast, standard, conservative, or custom).

params.name: admin
params.description: Governance address

params.name: template_name
params.description: Template name: 'fast', 'standard', 'conservative', or custom

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: Invoice identifier

params.name: sme_address
params.description: Invoice issuer

params.name: amount
params.description: Invoice face value

params.name: funding_token
params.description: SEP-41 funding token

params.name: treasury
params.description: Treasury address

params.name: registry
params.description: Optional registry hint

entrypoints.name: register_template
entrypoints.description: Admin stores a named custom template for later use by init_from_template.

params.name: name
params.description: Template name

params.name: template
params.description: Template configuration
